integrity.assumptions: Ordinary k-cut complex of the squared path; path reversal is the vertex involution.
integrity.scientific_status: A complete derivation and finite reproducibility checks support the rational character formula; no external audit.
integrity.scope: Every integer k at least 2 and n at least k+3.
integrity.source_boundary: Original 2024 shellability and 2026 nonequivariant enumeration are credited, not asserted as new.

scientific_limitations: Rational reversal-module classification only; no integral C2-lattice classification or fixed-space homotopy classification.
Relies on established shellability and explicit nonface characterization; finite tests are supporting checks, not an infinite proof.
Equivalent unindexed work is not excluded and independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Reversal character of squared-path cut-complex homology
